about: The apps the journey is qualified on: each a sentence a developer could say, the draft a model should write for it, and what it covers of prism/spec/1. `build` marks the six that are also built, sealed and tampered with. `refused` marks one that must be refused before any proof. The drafts Qwen3 30B wrote (qwen3-30b-drafts.recorded.jsonl) join them where they are accepted.

specs.covers: one number field, three answers
specs.sentence: Build an app that tells whether a visitor pays the child, adult or senior price from their age: under 13 is child, 65 and over is senior. Age is 0 to 120.

specs.covers: one choice field
specs.sentence: Build an app that says stop, wait or go from a traffic light that is red, amber or green.

specs.covers: two numbers, a field compared with a field, two answers
specs.sentence: Build an app that approves a payment when the amount is at most the limit and refuses it otherwise. Both are 0 to 10000.

specs.covers: choice and numbers mixed, field compared with a field, a stated guarantee that holds
specs.sentence: Build an app that approves a payment for a manager, approves it for a clerk only when the amount is at most their limit, and refuses it otherwise. A clerk must never be approved above their limit. Amount and limit are 0 to 5000.

properties.why: a clerk has no authority above their limit

specs.covers: the fixture: a choice and a number, overlapping rules with one answer
specs.sentence: Build an app that picks a shipping method: express when the destination is worldwide or the parcel weighs over 20 kg, otherwise standard. Weight is 0 to 50 kg; destination is domestic or worldwide.

specs.covers: rules that overlap with different answers: order decides
specs.sentence: Build an app that gives a member 20 percent off, gives anyone spending 100 or more 10 percent off, and gives nothing otherwise. Spend is 0 to 1000.

specs.covers: a rule no request reaches is kept and noted
specs.sentence: Build an app that passes a score of 50 or more, fails anything below, and marks a score of 60 or more as merit. Score is 0 to 100.

specs.covers: bounds at 0: a field whose only value is 0, and equality
specs.sentence: Build an app that says empty when the count is 0 and stocked otherwise. Count is 0 to 3, and reserved is always 0.

specs.covers: bounds at the largest number a spec allows
specs.sentence: Build an app that calls a balance large when it is at least 4503599627370496 and small otherwise. The balance is 0 to 9007199254740991, the largest whole number JSON carries exactly.

specs.covers: 24 rules, the most a spec allows
specs.sentence: Build an app that places a score from 0 to 100 into one of 25 bands of four points each.
specs.draft: generated: 24 rules `score >= 96 - 4k` answering band names in turn, otherwise the lowest band

specs.covers: two answers, a stated guarantee of each kind that holds
specs.sentence: Build an app that opens a gate for staff, and for a visitor only on an open day, and keeps it closed otherwise. A visitor must never get in on a closed day, and staff must always get in.

properties.why: the site is not safe for visitors on a closed day
staff must reach the site every day

specs.covers: many answers: seven, from one choice of seven
specs.sentence: Build an app that names the task for each day of the week: plan on Monday, build on Tuesday and Wednesday, test on Thursday, ship on Friday, and rest at the weekend.

specs.covers: choices only, three fields, `is not`
specs.sentence: Build an app that lets a post through when the author is verified and the post is not flagged, holds it when the author is new, and removes it otherwise. A flagged post must never go through.

properties.why: a flagged post may be harmful

specs.covers: numbers only, three fields, `=` and `!=`, two fields compared
specs.sentence: Build an app that calls a triangle of three whole sides, each 1 to 20, equilateral when all are equal, isosceles when two are, and scalene otherwise.

specs.covers: numbers with no bounds stated
specs.sentence: Build an app that says a count of items needs a second box when it is over 12, and one box otherwise.

specs.covers: three numbers, a range, a field compared with a field, three answers
specs.sentence: Build an app that decides a loan: approve when the credit score is at least 700 and the amount is at most the limit, refer when the score is 600 to 699, otherwise decline. Score is 300 to 850; amount and limit are 0 to 100000.

specs.covers: eight fields, the most a spec allows: more requests than Prism tries, so nothing is proposed
specs.sentence: Build an app that clears a shipment only when four checks each score at least 5 out of 9 and its origin, carrier, seal and paperwork are all in order.
specs.draft: generated: four number fields 0..9 and four choice fields, one rule over all eight

specs.covers: two numbers, three answers, both directions of an ordering
specs.sentence: Build a thermostat that heats below 18 degrees, cools above 24, and idles in between. Temperature is 0 to 40.

specs.covers: a number and a choice, four answers, rules in bands
specs.sentence: Build an app that prices parking: free for up to 1 hour, low for up to 4 hours, high beyond that, and always free at the weekend. Hours are 0 to 24.

specs.covers: a draft as a model writes it: `=` on a choice, a bare word for a field, `is not` on a number
specs.sentence: Build an app that passes an order when the customer is trusted and the total is at most the cap, and it is not zero, and holds it otherwise. Total and cap are 0 to 500.

specs.covers: a stated guarantee the rules break: refused at the draft, before any proof
specs.sentence: Build an app that opens a gate for staff and for a visitor on an open day. Nobody must ever get in on a closed day.

properties.why: the site is not safe on a closed day
